states.name: populated
states.description: 10 month cards, September of the selected school year through June of the next — each a plain element (not a nested custom element) inside app-calendario-view's single Shadow DOM, per CLAUDE.md's no-nested-Shadow-DOM rule. Each card's own elementId is data-element-id="calendario-month-<YYYY-MM>" (e.g. calendario-month-2026-09); each day cell inside it is data-element-id="calendario-month-<YYYY-MM>-day-<DD>" (e.g. calendario-month-2026-09-day-05) — this dynamic per-day naming is a documented pattern, not enumerated as individual static elementIds here, mirroring how key-date-settings-view.ts's row ids are generated per data row rather than declared statically. **2026-08-11**: a day cell covered by a calendario_horario row (see description_calendario.md's 'Horario' section) additionally carries a `data-calendario-horario="true"` attribute and a `#06b6d4` ring/border overlay around the day number — layered on top of whatever (category,type) fill color (if any) already covers that day, never replacing it; a day with only a horario row and no calendario_modulo entry shows the ring alone, on the plain background.
visual_cues: each day cell's fill follows UC-11's 14-row (category,type) color table
days spanning >30-day ranges show color only on their start and end day, not every day in between
days with more than one active category split their background into color stripes
a day covered by calendario_horario shows a cian (#06b6d4) ring/border around the day number, independent of and layered over the fill color

states.name: populated
states.description: Rendered (in the DOM, initially hidden via Tailwind's `hidden` class) for every day cell covered by at least one calendario_modulo entry and/or a calendario_horario row (2026-08-11) — one per day, dynamic id `calendario-month-<YYYY-MM>-day-<DD>-tooltip` (e.g. calendario-month-2026-09-day-05-tooltip), same dynamic-per-day convention already documented for calendario-months's own day-cell ids. Revealed by Tailwind's `group`/`group-hover:block` CSS pattern when the cursor is over that day's cell (the day cell itself carries `group relative`; the tooltip is `hidden group-hover:block absolute left-full top-0`, positioned immediately to the right of the cell it belongs to, never at a fixed screen corner) — no JS mouseover/mouseout handling needed, unlike the toast mechanism this replaces (2026-08-10). Content: the name of every calendario_modulo entry covering that day, one per line if more than one; plus, if that day has a calendario_horario row, one extra line "Horario: N horas" (N = that row's hours, 1-3) appended last.
visual_cues: small popup anchored to the right edge of the hovered day cell, appears/disappears immediately with the cursor, no fixed-corner positioning, no auto-dismiss timer

screens.notes: Own top-level custom element (app-calendario-view), reachable from the dashboard's existing calendar-card (src/frontend/src/dashboard-view.ts:22, route /calendario already wired, screen not yet implemented). Read-only — no CRUD from this screen. Renders exclusively from calendario_modulo, a snapshot table populated as a side effect of Año académico's 'Guardar selección' flow (see views/calendario/description_calendario.md) — never reads key_dates directly. Own single-use nav bar (not renderSettingsNav, which is specific to the four Configuración screens), same visual pattern (classesFor('card'), heading far left, link far right). The three filters cascade left to right: school year (simulated carousel, arrows, no real <select>) -> cycle -> módulo, each derived client-side from GET /api/academic-years/:id/modules the same way academic-year-settings-view.ts already derives training-cycle-table's distinct cycles. **2026-08-11**: also renders from calendario_horario (GET /api/calendario-horario?academicYearModuleId=...), a second, independent snapshot table populated as a side effect of Configuración → Horario's 'Guardar horario' flow (see description_calendario.md's 'Horario' section) — an overlay ring on calendario-months's day cells, an extra always-last item in calendario-legend, and an extra line in calendario-day-tooltip, never a fill color of its own and never mixed into the UC-11 color table.
